meta.name: OPEN BAR Nocturnal Glass Atelier
meta.description: A dark, tactile menu-bar atelier. Three luminous virtual bars are the product. Vertical drag between them is the primary gesture. Surfaces are glass, specular, and springy — never a generic list console.
source_references: Original OPEN BAR three-lane drag interaction
macOS menu bar and Dynamic Island material language

neutral.usage: Ink ground, cool glass steps, muted metadata, warm paper in light mode

color.contrast_strategy: Dark studio with a single luminous accent family; section tints are glow, not paint

typography.font_style_notes: Display titles are large and quiet. Overlines are tracked labels for the three bars. Never use a rounded novelty face.

spacing.section_rhythm: 12px inside a virtual bar, 28px between the three bars, 32px around the stage

layout.grid_system: Full-width stage under a floating top chrome; three stacked virtual menu bars

shape.border_usage: 1px specular highlight on the top edge of glass islands
shape.divider_style: Almost none; space and glow separate the three bars

elevation.shadow_style: colored glow plus deep studio drop
elevation.depth_cues: Inner top highlight, colored ambient glow, icon lift on hover

iconography.style: Real application icons sitting on a menu-bar island, 28px, with a live status speck
iconography.preferred_set: Live app icons plus SF Symbols for chrome

motion.philosophy: Physical: icons lift, bars bloom when they can receive a drop

components.button_style: Pill chrome; AI is a luminous capsule with colored bloom
components.input_style: Glass search field, 36px tall, no hard rectangle
components.card_style: The only cards are the three virtual menu bars — glass islands, not list rows
components.navigation_pattern: Floating top chrome with a capsule page switcher
components.modal_style: Glass sheet with two miniature menu-bar previews
components.list_style: Unused on the home stage; activity uses soft glass rows
components.component_notes: Never replace the three bars with an inbox. Drag is vertical between bars only.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Three physical menu bars floating in a dark atelier, waiting to receive icons
aesthetic.era_influence: Apple spatial material, Dynamic Island, high-end instrument panels

visual_language.ornamentation: specular edges and colored bloom only
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Wide stage, dense icons on each bar
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: The three islands carry all weight; chrome recedes
visual_language.focal_strategy: Glow on the active drop target and the hovering icon
visual_language.texture_usage: Frosted glass, inner highlight, atmospheric radial wash

composition.hierarchy_method: Scale of the three bars, then glow, then type
composition.flow_direction: top chrome, then downward through Shown → Hidden → Always Hidden
composition.negative_space_role: Makes the bars feel like objects in space

imagery.graphic_elements: Status specks, specular rims, aurora wash
imagery.image_shape: 28px app icons with a 7px live speck

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Spring lift, bloom, and a name capsule
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Icon rises 4px and scales to 1.14; bar warms
interaction_feel.loading_style: Sparkles plus inline progress in the AI capsule

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: An empty island still looks like a menu bar

overview.fallback_strategy: Keep fills and hide bloom when Reduce Motion is on
overview.primary_technology: SwiftUI materials, radial atmosphere, spring animations

background_effects.description: Two large radial washes — teal top-left, periwinkle bottom-right — on ink

3d_elements.description: Depth is simulated with glow and lift, not a 3D renderer

text_effects.description: Static type; hover names fade and scale from the icon

cursor_effects.description: Native pointer; the icon and bar react instead

image_effects.description: Icons lift with a colored contact shadow on hover

visual_effects.composite_notes: The three virtual bars must read as objects. Bloom on drop-target, specular rim, and icon lift are the entire effects budget.
